steps.text: They told me it was all over.
My homeland, my companions, everything buried now.
But I knew, it had only just begun.
...And I'm on my way.
04:50 P.M. \ Overcast
A town in northern Kazimierz

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Here you go. Bread and clean water, all in here.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Incredible, you are! Fought 'em off, no, wiped 'em out alone, all those gloompincers... Didn't expect one young lady like you'd finish up that job in half an afternoon.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Even going out all together, the young'uns couldn't handle it.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Frankly, it gave me a scare, our town being so small. And I've never seen someone fight as ferocious as you.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: ...I'll be fine without.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Don't want any bread or water? Well... alright, we've got some medicine here too.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: It's from the caravan that passed through last time. We had to trade them a good amount for it. They were worth plenty, I'll tell you.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: By the sights of it, you've been hurt bad, haven't you? You could probably use it.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I don't need it.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Th-Then what do you need? Gold coins? That'll be tough. We're only a little town, and rabble comes by shaking us down every few days, plus all the beasts making trouble out there...

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Our pockets are all emptied out by the end of the year. Barely a penny we've got.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: The day before. People sighted a Kuranta the day before, black clothing and a crossbow, heading this way.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Tell me where they are.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Crossbow? The kind you use for hunting?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: The kind to murder.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: M-Murder?

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: You've got to be joking... no, the look in your eyes says you aren't joking one bit... how frightful... *cough* How could someone like that show up in a little place like ours?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Don't screw with me.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: I-I-I-I-Is that a weapon? Don't, erm, please don't shoot! I swear, I haven't seen anyone like the person you describe—

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: The ones in the last village saw. And told me. They went this way.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Per... perhaps they already passed through here, went south? There's an even bigger town that way, more food, cleaner water...

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Oh, god, Heaven above! Miss, god, believe me, please, I've got no reason to lie to you at all.

steps.name: Kazimierz Villager
steps.text: Look, please, here, this is the last of my family's money, we were saving it for the year-end tax, this is all we've got, have it, have it all...

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I said, I don't need it.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Forget it. You can go.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Another day, empty-handed.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: But no matter. You can't hide much longer.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I'll be following you. All the way—until I find you, one, by one, all of you.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: What's this?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Bread, and water. And medicine.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: He was scared so bad, he ran off without a trace, and yet he still deliberately came back in after.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Is he trying to show thanks? But it was only a few gloompincers, nothing more. It took no effort on my part.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: People like him... do remind me... of back then.
Grandpa, who are they? Are they the nice knights everyone talks about?
They aren't...?
Are the things they're carrying like the ones the bad people use to pick on us?
I... I'm sort of scared.
But they're good people, right? They helped us fight off the bad people.
I want to say thank you to them.
I don't really have any good stuff to give them. Would this half of my scone be okay? I can play a harmonica song for them too.
Mm-hm, I hope they can stay with.
With all of us, forever.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Now all that's left is this harmonica.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Nice knights? *sigh*...

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Whether then, or now... it's all the same.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: If they're still around... if...

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: It's too bad—there is no 'if.'

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: Hey, someone's here!

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: Whoa, and a bunch of food—not much good, but good enough to eat tonight.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Leave.

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: Did you just tell me to leave? Who do you think you are?

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: It's just sitting here. Is there a name on it? I don't see you eating it. I found it now, so it's mine.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Then just take it and get lost.

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: Wait up, what's that you're holding? A harmonica? Heh, some tacky toy. Whatever. Take it to the city, you might find some boring old guy who thinks it's worth something.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: This is not for you to touch.

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: Oh, you talk pretty tough, don't you?

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: Who do you even think I am, brat?

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: Just look at you. How long has it been since you ate something?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I'm warning you—*cough*, *cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: Jeez. You seem pretty sick at that. You'd best believe I could knock you over with a single poke.

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: What'cha playing at? Don't spook me now, it's dark out here. You think you can threaten anyone with a bare tree branch?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I gave you plenty of warning. You didn't listen.

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: Ow, ff-ow-ow-ow—that's a crossbow! That's the kind that kills people, isn't it?!

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Get. Lost.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I don't want to kill anyone tonight. At the very least, not you.

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: Spare me... bud, just spare me! You can have this, have it all back.

steps.name: Kazimierz Ruffian
steps.text: I'm outta here, I promise!

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Mm... *cough* *cough*, *cough* *cough* *cough*.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Who's there?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I have to stay up... stay awake.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I still haven't... I...
I still haven't found those traitors yet.
So long as that day doesn't come, they can never rest in peace—
And I can never, ever stop.
Hello? Are you okay?
Seems she hasn't passed out completely... though she's at the point she can't stand.
Identity confirmation... yes, just like in the mission description. This should be the target, no mistake.
Serious wounds, fever temperatures, and gravely malnourished... she hasn't eaten properly in forever, and hasn't slept, either.
Nutritional supplements... and some emergency meds... Lucky I packed enough for the road. Dr. Kal'tsit really sees every last thing coming.
You're up.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Who are you?!

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Don't be alarmed, I mean you no harm. I'm employed by a pharmaceutical company named Rhodes Island. I'm responsible for field work in this area. Here, this is my work ID.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: That doesn't prove anything. IDs and papers and whatever can all be forged.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Fair enough, they can. Haha, you're just like I heard. An extremely cautious youngster.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Heard? From who?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Oh, jeez, don't get all tense again.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Look, I'm serious, I'm not anyone bad. I don't even have any weapons that big or lethal on me. At best, I've got a couple of tools for defending myself from beasts.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I've got nothing on you. I see that crossbow of yours... look, it's still right there. You could reach out and grab it.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Can we have a real talk now?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: If you're up to something, you'll regret having stepped into this forest.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Yes. I believe you. The crossbow in your hands has already told me that much.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Right now, you need to tell me. Who was it that told you anything about me?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: That's... er...

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: There's been reports of a very young Elafia girl who's been all around the northern villages of Kazimierz lately, looking for any leads on a specific group. Plenty of people have been picking up on it, actually.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: The footprints left behind when tracking prey.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I wouldn't have made a mistake like that in the past... but I don't care that I have.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Who told you to look for me?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: That'd be Rhodes Island. Just like I introduced earlier, Rhodes Island is a pharmaceutical company, doing business in all areas. They've been seeking all sorts of suitable talent, too, and they'd like to invite you to join.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: A pharmaceutical company?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Did you drug me just now?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Only some nutritional supplements and a simple first-aid medication. I'm no Medic Operator. I personally can't give you any better of an examination, nor further treatment.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: You look a good bit better now, luckily. Your injuries should be holding decently. If we want any further diagnosis, you'll need to come back to Rhodes Island with me.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: To treat me. And you want to hire me.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Seeing as you've investigated, you should already know. I don't understand the first thing about medicine. The only thing I can do is fight.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: So, what would a pharmaceutical company want a hired bow for?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Er... oh, boy, that one... er, like I said earlier, Rhodes Island does a lot of business, and frequently comes into contact with a lot of different people in a lot of different areas.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: And during those contacts, we unavoidably run into some emergencies.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: At times like that, we need people with special skills like yours, to help give Rhodes Island a fighting chance.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Whether person or organization, you have to have strength if you want to survive.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Right. I'm sure you can understand.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: But my strength has other uses.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Do you mean those people you're looking for?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Every day I haven't found them is one more day my footsteps will not cease.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I understand... I'm not too clear about your past, but it's a very common thing, isn't it? Just like us inside Rhodes Island. We've got scores of operators, all with their own differing and individual attachments.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: We won't ever interfere in an operator's private affairs, and outside of missions, everyone has freedom.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Beyond that, when an operator needs it, providing aid doesn't go against our standards, Rhodes Island will provide whatever you want—medical service, crucial information, or necessary strength.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: It's why a good few Operators chose to join Rhodes Island, really.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Then the people I need to find...

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Can Rhodes Island help me there?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: It's not my place to say anything else. Just, us helping you look for someone—that'd be more effective than you going it alone around Kazimierz, or even areas beyond, right?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: Alone, you probably wouldn't hold out for too long. You're short on supplies, and you don't have any help.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I'll be honest, you're not in the best of shape right now. If you need to find someone, accomplish some goal, then first you need to ensure your survival, right?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: How do I put it? In our world, if you want to get something done, even if it's as bare and simple as staying alive, a bunch of heads all together always beats one.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: (Days with no help, only able to rely on myself to live... It's not like I've never gone through times like these.)

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: (The feeling of someone there to help... I can't deny... day in, day out, I miss it.)

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: (In that case, this should go a little quicker now.)

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Rhodes Island... a pharmaceutical company. Not out to do anything bad, right?

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: On that point, you can rest assured.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Alright. So long as you're willing to lend me more strength—

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I can lend my strength to you.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I'll join.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: That's wonderful, then! I won't ask for much more information. Once we get back to Rhodes Island, there'll be HR operators who'll check with you separately.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: After all the red tape's done with, you can officially become a Rhodes Island Operator.

steps.name: Field Operator
steps.text: I think I can say it'll be a delight to work together with, er...? Um, what should I call you?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: ...Firewatch.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Past, present, future... no matter where I am.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Until I find every last traitor, until I fulfill my revenge—

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: This will be the only name I possess.
